name: Singapore Business Agent Suite

tagline: One unified ecosystem. Six Singapore business domains. 71 statutory agent capabilities.

plugins.name: Singapore Tax Intelligence

plugins.name: Singapore HR & Manpower Intelligence

plugins.name: Singapore Legal & Secretarial Intelligence

plugins.name: Singapore Corporate Finance Intelligence

plugins.name: Singapore Strategic Planning Intelligence

plugins.name: Singapore Marketing & Growth Intelligence
